### 5.2.2 Computational Mechanics and Psychological Dynamics

To understand why persuasive software warrants the application of a strict product liability regime, we must meticulously dissect the intersection between the computational mechanics underpinning transformational architectures and the human psychological vulnerabilities exploited by these systems. Computationally, large language models operate through next-token prediction mechanisms based on probability weights learned from trillions of text data corpora.
